main.remarks: Encodes the default access-management policy behavior for authorization, issuance, and revocation.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create the singleton default access-policy engine.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate the supplied access-policy context using the default access-management rules.
method.returns: Policy decision for the supplied context.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate the supplied access-policy context asynchronously using the default access-management rules.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous policy evaluation.
method.returns: Policy decision for the supplied context.

method.name: EvaluateAccess
method.summary: Evaluate protected-operation authorization using the default rules.

method.name: EvaluateAccessAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously protected-operation authorization using the default rules.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous protected-operation evaluation.

method.name: EvaluateAuthorization
method.summary: Evaluate claim-only authorization using the default rules.

method.name: EvaluateAuthorizationAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously claim-only authorization using the default rules.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous authorization evaluation.

method.name: EvaluateIssuance
method.summary: Evaluate access-key issuance using the default rules.

method.name: EvaluateIssuanceAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously access-key issuance using the default rules.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous issuance evaluation.

method.name: EvaluateRequest
method.summary: Evaluate access-key request normalization results using the default rules.

method.name: EvaluateRevocation
method.summary: Evaluate access-key revocation using the default rules.

method.name: EvaluateRevocationAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously access-key revocation using the default rules.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous revocation evaluation.
